summary: Website project: improve overall design (Figma-led) while fixing core functionality including WhatsApp/Telegram redirects, working forms (with timer-based lock/log per roadmap), proper form submissions across the site, and a functioning search box; page structure can be multipage or single-scroll.
architectural_notes: Site structure is flexible: may be multipage or single-scroll, whichever improves UX and implementation.
known_issues: Current design is considered unacceptable/too ugly by user.
WhatsApp/Telegram redirect functionality is broken or unreliable.
Forms (including primary forms with timer lock/log requirements) are not working properly.
Search box is not working properly.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Abstract premium hero background with subtle gold/charcoal gradients and light noise texture (hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Minimal monoline icon set (telegram, whatsapp, search, form) in a consistent style (ui-icons.dim_512x512.png)
- Soft section-divider graphic with smoky/gold motif (section-divider.dim_1920x240.png)

existing_features.title: Apply a cohesive, modern visual redesign across the entire site (Figma-inspired), improving typography, spacing, color system, and component styling so the site no longer looks "ugly" while keeping all existing pages/routes functional.

Fix all Telegram and WhatsApp redirects so every Telegram/WhatsApp button/link consistently opens the correct URL in a new tab/window using the centralized constants in frontend/src/constants/socialLinks.ts.

Ensure both primary registration forms (Presale and Airdrop) submit successfully and reliably, including correct backend submission, clear success/error toasts, correct WhatsApp redirect after successful submission, and proper disabled/loading states.

Implement timer-based locking behavior for Presale and Airdrop forms according to the roadmap timers: forms must be locked/unlocked strictly based on the backend timer values (presale/airdrop remaining time) and must not allow submission while locked.

Add submission logging/visibility that reflects the timer context: after a successful Presale/Airdrop submission, the user can see a simple log entry showing what was submitted and when (timestamp), and it remains consistent with backend-stored submission records.
Fix all other form submissions across the site so they behave correctly with clear validation and user feedback (success/error) and do not silently fail.
Implement a working search box that allows users to search site content/pages and navigate to relevant results (multipage routing).
Keep the site as a multipage application (existing router-based navigation), while improving usability (navigation clarity, consistent page shells/headers/footers) as part of the redesign.

new_feature_requests.summary: Redesign/improve website UI/UX (Figma-led); overall make design better (multipage or single-scroll allowed).
Fix WhatsApp and Telegram redirection functionality.
Ensure both primary forms work properly with timer-based locking/logging per roadmap.
Fix all other form submissions across the site to work properly.
Fix/implement search box functionality to work properly.

projectName: Redesign site UI and fix social redirects, forms, timers, and search
